name: backlog_knows_landed

name: board_is_printed_by_the_cli_first

name: board_never_hand_built

name: backlog_releases_are_fix_versions

name: backlog_approval_one_line_per_criterion

name: backlog_order_is_the_owners

why: after 4.0.0, LeSS (owner: 'fix this: What is not solid yet' — backlog order was RICE plus overrides; the review asked to 'accept')
